exercises.name: Banded Push-Up
exercises.setup: Band across upper back, one end trapped under each palm. Elbows ~45 deg from torso.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Banded Push-Up
exercises.setup: Same as banded push-up but hands under shoulders, elbows tight to ribs.

exercises.name: Standing Chest Press
exercises.setup: Band around upper back and under armpits, ends in each hand. Press straight forward to lockout.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Standing Chest Press
exercises.setup: Anchor at chest height behind you, stagger stance, press one arm forward. Resist torso rotation.

exercises.name: Door-Anchor Chest Fly
exercises.setup: Anchor at chest height behind you. Arms wide with soft elbows, sweep hands together in front of sternum.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Chest Fly
exercises.setup: Anchor low behind you. Sweep hands up and in, finishing at collarbone height. Targets upper chest.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Chest Fly
exercises.setup: Anchor high behind you. Sweep hands down and in, finishing at hip height. Targets lower chest.

exercises.name: Banded Floor Press
exercises.setup: Lie on back, band under your upper back, ends in each hand. Press up until arms lock.

exercises.name: Standing Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, feet shoulder width. Hands at shoulder height, press overhead without flaring ribs.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Stand on band with one foot, press one arm overhead. Resist side-bending.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Half-kneeling, band under front foot. Press overhead. Squeeze the down-leg glute to lock the pelvis.

exercises.name: Banded Pike Push-Up
exercises.setup: Band across upper back, hands under palms, hips piked high. Lower crown of head toward floor.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Raise
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, arms at sides. Raise to shoulder height with soft elbows, pinkies slightly high.

exercises.name: Banded Front Raise
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, raise straight arms forward to eye level.

exercises.name: Banded Upright Row
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, pull hands up along body to lower-chest height, elbows leading.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.setup: Hold band at shoulder width, arms straight in front. Pull apart to chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Overhead Band Pull-Apart
exercises.setup: Arms overhead holding band. Pull apart and lower slightly behind head, then return.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.setup: Anchor at head height. Pull toward forehead, elbows high and wide, externally rotate at the end.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall, legs straight, band looped around both feet. Row to lower ribs, elbows close.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hinge to ~45 deg with a flat back. Row band to your hips.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bent-Over Row
exercises.setup: Stand on band with opposite foot, hinge, row one arm to hip. Resist trunk rotation.

exercises.name: Door-Anchor Horizontal Row
exercises.setup: Anchor at chest height, step back into tension. Row to ribs, shoulder blades back and down.

exercises.name: Kneeling Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Anchor high, kneel facing it. Pull hands down and out to collarbone level, elbows to ribs.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.setup: Anchor high, arms straight overhead. Sweep arms down to thighs keeping elbows locked.

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.setup: Loop band over bar, knee or foot in the loop. Requires a pull-up bar - skip if unavailable.

exercises.name: Wide High Row
exercises.setup: Anchor slightly above head. Pull wide toward upper chest with flared elbows.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Reverse Fly
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band with crossed grip, hinge forward. Raise straight arms out to a T.

exercises.name: Band Shrug
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, arms straight down. Shrug shoulders to ears, pause, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
exercises.setup: Hold band with light tension. Trace Y, then T, then W shapes. Great for shoulder health.

exercises.name: Banded Bicep Curl
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, palms forward, elbows pinned to sides. Curl to shoulders.

exercises.name: Banded Hammer Curl
exercises.setup: Same as curl but neutral (thumbs-up) grip throughout.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Curl
exercises.setup: Stand on band with one foot, curl one arm. Slow 3s negative.

exercises.name: Banded Reverse Curl
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, overhand grip. Curl up keeping wrists straight.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.setup: Anchor high, elbows pinned to ribs. Extend forearms down to full lockout.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, run it up your back, hands behind your head with elbows high. Extend arms overhead.

exercises.name: Tricep Kickback
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hinge forward, upper arms parallel to torso. Extend elbows straight back.

exercises.name: Banded Skull Crusher
exercises.setup: Anchor low, lie on floor with head toward anchor. Elbows fixed and vertical, extend hands to ceiling.

exercises.name: Banded Squat
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, loop ends over both shoulders. Squat to depth, drive knees out.

exercises.name: Banded Front Squat
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, band in a front-rack position at collarbones. Stay upright as you squat.

exercises.name: Banded Goblet Squat
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hands held together at chest. Squat with an upright torso.

exercises.name: Banded Split Squat
exercises.setup: Front foot on band, ends over shoulders. Drop back knee toward floor, drive through front heel.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.setup: Rear foot on a chair, front foot on band with ends at shoulders. Slow descent.

exercises.name: Banded Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Front foot on band, ends over shoulders. Step the other leg back, drop and return.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Lunge
exercises.setup: Stand on band with the stationary foot. Step wide to the side, sit into that hip, push back.

exercises.name: Banded Step-Up
exercises.setup: Band under the stepping foot on a sturdy chair, ends at shoulders. Drive up without pushing off the back foot.

exercises.name: Banded Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hands at thighs. Push hips back with a flat back, feel the hamstring stretch, drive hips forward.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.setup: Stand on band with one foot, hinge over that leg with the other extending behind. Keep hips square.

exercises.name: Banded Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, squat down to grip both ends. Drive floor away, lock out hips and knees together.

exercises.name: Banded Sumo Deadlift
exercises.setup: Wide stance on band, toes out. Grip between legs and stand tall.

exercises.name: Banded Good Morning
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, ends over shoulders behind neck. Hinge forward to near-parallel with a flat back.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Swing
exercises.setup: Anchor low behind you, band between legs. Hinge and snap hips forward, kettlebell-swing style.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on back, band over hips with ends pinned under your hands on the floor. Drive hips up, squeeze glutes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Glute bridge with one foot off the floor. Keep hips level throughout.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Upper back on a couch or chair, band over hips anchored under your feet. Thrust to full hip extension.

exercises.name: Banded Frog Pump
exercises.setup: Lie on back, soles of feet together and knees wide, band over hips. Pulse hips up.

exercises.name: Banded Hamstring Curl
exercises.setup: Lie face down, band looped around one ankle with the other end pinned under the opposite knee. Curl the heel toward your glutes.

exercises.name: Standing Glute Kickback
exercises.setup: Quadruped, band looped around one foot with the ends pinned under both hands. Drive the leg back to full hip extension.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.setup: Stand on the band with one foot, other end looped around the opposite ankle. Sweep that leg out to the side.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk
exercises.setup: Band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Quarter-squat and step sideways, keeping tension.

exercises.name: Monster Walk
exercises.setup: Band around thighs. Step forward and diagonally out, alternating, staying in a quarter-squat.

exercises.name: Banded Clamshell
exercises.setup: Side-lying, band around thighs, knees bent. Open the top knee without rolling the hips back.

exercises.name: Banded Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, ends at shoulders or hips. Rise onto toes, pause 1s at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Band under one foot, ends held at hip. Rise onto that toe with a slow lower.

exercises.name: Wall Sit with Abduction
exercises.setup: Wall sit against the RV, truck, or a tree with the band around your thighs. Pulse the knees out against the band. Time-based.

exercises.name: Banded Squat Jump
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, ends at shoulders. Squat and jump explosively, land soft. Skip if joints are cranky.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension
exercises.setup: Anchor low, band behind one knee, step away into tension. Straighten the knee against the pull.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.setup: Anchor at chest height, stand side-on. Press hands straight out from sternum and resist the twist.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
exercises.setup: Half-kneeling side-on to the anchor. Press out and hold 2s. Harder to cheat than standing.

exercises.name: Anti-Rotation Hold
exercises.setup: Pallof position, press out and simply hold. Time-based, 20-40s per side.

exercises.name: Kneeling Band Crunch
exercises.setup: Anchor high, kneel facing away, hands at ears. Crunch ribs toward hips - flex the spine, do not hinge.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Woodchop
exercises.setup: Anchor high, stand side-on. Pull diagonally down and across to the opposite hip, pivoting the back foot.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Woodchop
exercises.setup: Stand on the band with one foot, both hands at the opposite hip. Sweep diagonally up and across above the far shoulder.

exercises.name: Banded Russian Twist
exercises.setup: Sit leaned back, band around both feet, ends in both hands. Rotate hands across the body under control.

exercises.name: Banded Dead Bug
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, band looped around both feet with the ends in your hands, arms straight up. Extend opposite arm and leg, keep the low back flat.

exercises.name: Banded Reverse Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, band around both feet, ends gripped in your hands pressed into the floor behind your head. Curl knees to chest, lifting the hips.

exercises.name: Banded Leg Raise
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, band around both feet, ends pinned under your hands overhead. Raise straight legs to vertical, lower slowly without arching.

exercises.name: Banded Flutter Kick
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, band around both feet, ends pinned overhead under your hands. Small alternating kicks, low back flat. Time-based.

exercises.name: Banded Sit-Up
exercises.setup: Anchor low behind your head, hold band at chest. Sit all the way up against the resistance.

exercises.name: Banded Plank
exercises.setup: Band across upper back, ends under hands, in a plank. Brace hard. Time-based.

exercises.name: Plank Band Row
exercises.setup: High plank, band looped around one hand and pinned under the opposite palm. Row one arm without letting the hips rotate.

exercises.name: Banded Mountain Climber
exercises.setup: Band around both feet in a high plank. Drive knees to chest alternately. Time-based.

exercises.name: Side Plank with Abduction
exercises.setup: Side plank with band around thighs. Raise the top leg against the band. Time-based.

exercises.name: Banded Bird Dog
exercises.setup: Quadruped, band looped from one hand to the opposite foot. Extend both, pause, return.

exercises.name: Banded Side Bend
exercises.setup: Stand on band with one foot, band in the same-side hand. Bend away from it, then return to upright.

exercises.name: Banded V-Up
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, band around both feet, ends held overhead. Lift legs and torso to meet in a V.

exercises.name: Banded Hollow Hold
exercises.setup: Hollow-body position, band around both feet with ends held overhead, arms locked. Time-based.

exercises.name: Banded Thruster
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hands at shoulders. Squat, then drive up and press overhead in one motion.

exercises.name: Squat to Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Same as thruster but pause at the top of the squat before pressing. Slower and more controlled.

exercises.name: Deadlift to High Pull
exercises.setup: Band deadlift, then continue into an upright row to chin height.

exercises.name: Banded Clean and Press
exercises.setup: From a hinge, pull the band explosively to the shoulders, then press overhead.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge with Press
exercises.setup: Front foot on band. Step back into a lunge and press overhead as you stand.

exercises.name: Push-Up to Row
exercises.setup: Banded push-up (band across upper back), then a single-arm row with the band pinned under the opposite palm. Both sides = one rep.

exercises.name: Banded Burpee
exercises.setup: Band across upper back for the push-up portion. Full burpee, stand tall each rep.

exercises.name: Banded Bear Crawl
exercises.setup: Band around thighs, knees hovering. Crawl forward and back with hips low. Time-based.

exercises.name: Banded Sprinter Pull
exercises.setup: Anchor low, band around one ankle, face away. Drive the knee up hard and fast, sprinter style.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Pass-Through
exercises.setup: Wide grip on band, sweep from hips overhead and behind you, then back. Widen grip if it feels tight.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Hip Hinge
exercises.setup: Slow hinges to groove the pattern before loading it.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.setup: Quadruped spinal flexion and extension, slow and breathing.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.setup: Deep lunge, elbow to instep, then rotate the top arm to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.setup: Progressively larger circles forward and back.

exercises.name: Banded Lat Stretch
exercises.setup: Anchor high, hold band with one hand and step back, hinging to let the lat lengthen. 30s per side.

exercises.name: Banded Shoulder Distraction
exercises.setup: Band around the wrist at chest height, step away and let it gently traction the shoulder. 30s per side.

exercises.name: Standing Chest Stretch
exercises.setup: Clasp your hands behind your back, straighten the arms and lift the chest, drawing the shoulder blades together. 30s.

exercises.name: Banded Hamstring Stretch
exercises.setup: Lie on back, band around one foot, draw the straight leg toward you. 30s per side.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.setup: Half-kneeling, squeeze the down-side glute and shift forward. 30s per side.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Glute Stretch
exercises.setup: On your back, ankle over opposite knee, pull the thigh in. 30s per side.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.setup: Sit hips to heels, arms long, breathe. 45s.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.setup: Prone, press chest up with soft elbows to lengthen the abs. 30s.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation
exercises.setup: Side-lying, knees stacked, open the top arm and follow it with your eyes. 30s per side.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch
exercises.setup: Press the ball of one foot against a tree or the RV tire with the heel down, knee straight then slightly bent. 30s per side.

exercises.name: Staggered-Stance Pallof Press
exercises.setup: Stand on the band with one foot, both hands together at the sternum. Press straight out and resist the diagonal pull. Switch feet to switch sides.

exercises.name: Banded Suitcase Hold
exercises.setup: Stand on the band with one foot, hold the other end in the same-side hand at your side. Stand tall and refuse to side-bend. Time-based.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Band Chop
exercises.setup: Half-kneeling with the band under the front foot. Pull diagonally up and across to the opposite shoulder, hips square.

exercises.name: Plank Band Drag
exercises.setup: High plank with the band looped around one wrist and pinned under the opposite hand. Drag the hand across and back without rocking the hips.

exercises.name: Banded Overhead March
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, press both hands overhead and hold. March knees to hip height without letting the ribs flare. Time-based.

exercises.name: Self-Anchored Band Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, band around both feet, ends held at your chest. Crunch the ribs toward the hips against the band.

exercises.name: Standing Band Side Crunch
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, opposite-side hand holding the end overhead. Crunch sideways, pulling the ribs toward the hip.

exercises.name: Floor Band Pullover
exercises.setup: Lie on your back with the band pinned under your hips, ends in both hands. Sweep straight arms from overhead down to your thighs.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Y-Raise
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hinge forward. Raise straight arms into a Y overhead, thumbs up. Substitutes for face pulls with no anchor.

exercises.name: Squat to Band Chop
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, hands at one hip. Squat, then stand and sweep the band diagonally overhead to the far side.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge to Chop
exercises.setup: Front foot on the band. Step back into a lunge, then drive up and chop the band diagonally across and overhead.

exercises.name: Standing Lat Side Bend
exercises.setup: Reach one arm overhead and lean away, breathing into the ribs. 30s per side. No anchor needed.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Stretch
exercises.setup: Wide grip on the band, slowly pass it overhead and behind you, pausing where it's tight. 30s.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands at your ears. Curl the shoulder blades off the ground, chin off chest. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Sit all the way up until your chest meets your thighs, lower under control.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.setup: Forearms under shoulders, body in one line from heels to head. Squeeze glutes, tuck the ribs down. Time-based.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.setup: On one forearm, elbow under shoulder, feet stacked. Drive the hip up so the body makes a straight line. Time-based per side.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
exercises.setup: From a side plank, lower the hip toward the ground and drive it back up without rotating.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.setup: On your back, hands at ears. Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg extends. Rotate the torso, not just the elbow.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.setup: On your back, knees bent over hips, hands flat beside you. Curl the hips off the floor to bring knees to chest.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.setup: On your back, hands under your glutes. Raise straight legs to vertical, lower slowly and stop before the low back arches.

exercises.name: Flutter Kick
exercises.setup: On your back, legs straight and just off the ground, hands under your glutes. Small alternating kicks. Time-based.

exercises.name: Heel Tap
exercises.setup: On your back, knees bent, shoulders slightly off the floor. Bend side to side tapping each heel.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.setup: Sit with knees bent, torso leaned back to ~45 deg, feet hovering. Rotate the shoulders side to side under control.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.setup: On your back, arms up and knees over hips. Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor keeping the low back flat, then switch.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.setup: On hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg to full length. Keep the hips level and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
exercises.setup: High plank, feet wide. Tap the opposite shoulder with each hand while refusing to let the hips rock.

exercises.name: Plank Up-Down
exercises.setup: From a forearm plank, press up to a high plank one arm at a time, then back down. Keep the hips still.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.setup: On your back, arms overhead. Lift legs and torso at once to touch hands to feet, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.setup: On your back, low back pressed flat, arms and legs extended and hovering. Time-based. Bend the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Boat Hold
exercises.setup: Sit balanced on your tailbone, shins parallel to the ground, chest tall. Time-based.

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper
exercises.setup: On your back, arms out wide, legs up. Lower both legs to one side under control, then the other. Shoulders stay pinned.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.setup: Face down, arms extended. Lift chest, arms and legs off the ground, pause, lower. Balances all the forward flexion work.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.setup: Hands at shoulder height on any solid vertical surface — the side of the RV, the truck, or a tree trunk. Lower the chest to it and press back. The easiest push-up regression.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.setup: Hands on a tailgate, bench, or rock; body in a straight line. The higher the hands, the easier.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.setup: Push-up from the knees, hips extended so the body stays straight from knee to head.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.setup: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, elbows ~45 deg from the torso. Lower the chest to fist height, press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Wide Push-Up
exercises.setup: Push-up with hands well outside shoulder width. Biases the chest over the triceps.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.setup: Hands together forming a triangle under the sternum, elbows tight to the ribs.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.setup: Feet up on a tailgate or step, hands on the ground. Shifts load to the upper chest and shoulders.

exercises.name: Archer Push-Up
exercises.setup: Wide hands. Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. A step toward the one-arm push-up.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.setup: Hips piked high, hands and feet close. Lower the crown of your head toward the ground between your hands.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.setup: High plank, arms locked. Move only the shoulder blades — pinch them together, then push the floor away. Great warm-up.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W
exercises.setup: Face down, arms making a Y, then a T, then a W. Lift the hands a few inches and squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.setup: Hands on a tailgate or bench behind you, legs out front. Lower until the elbows hit ~90 deg, press back up. Keep the shoulders down.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.setup: Grip a waist-height bar — RV ladder rung, picnic table edge, low branch — and hang underneath with a straight body. Pull the chest to the bar. Walk the feet in to make it easier.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.setup: Overhand grip on a branch or ladder rung, hang at full stretch. Pull until the chin clears. Use a band under one foot to assist.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.setup: Underhand grip, shoulder width. Easier than a pull-up and hits the biceps harder.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.setup: Simply hang from a branch or rung with straight arms and shoulders engaged. Time-based. Builds the grip and shoulder position pull-ups need.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.setup: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out. Sit down and back, knees tracking over the toes, chest tall. Stand and squeeze the glutes.

exercises.name: Squat Pulse
exercises.setup: Hold the bottom of a squat and pulse a few inches up and down. Time-based.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.setup: Squat, then jump as high as you can. Land softly through the whole foot and absorb into the next rep.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.setup: Hinge, swing the arms, jump forward as far as you can. Stick the landing, walk back, repeat.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Step one leg straight back, drop the back knee toward the ground, drive through the front heel to stand.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.setup: Lunge forward, then bring the back leg through into the next lunge. Torso upright throughout.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.setup: Step wide to one side, sit into that hip while the other leg stays straight, push back to center.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.setup: Step one leg diagonally behind the other, drop into a lunge. Hits the side of the glute.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.setup: Rear foot on a tailgate or bench, front foot a stride ahead. Drop straight down, drive through the front heel.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.setup: Step onto a bumper, step, or rock. Drive through the top-foot heel without pushing off the bottom foot.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.setup: One leg extended forward, squat down on the other to full depth and stand. Hold a tree or the RV for balance while learning.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.setup: Wide stance. Shift all the way over one bent leg while the other stays straight, then shift across to the other side.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: On your back, knees bent, feet flat and close to your glutes. Drive the hips up, squeeze hard at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Glute bridge with one foot off the floor and that knee hugged in. Keep the hips level.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Good Morning
exercises.setup: Hands behind your head. Push the hips back with a flat back until you feel the hamstrings, then drive the hips forward.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.setup: Hinge over one leg, the other extending straight behind you, hips square. Reach toward the ground and return.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.setup: Kneel with your heels hooked under the RV step or truck frame. Lower your torso forward as slowly as you can, catch with your hands, push back. Brutal — start with 3 reps.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.setup: Back flat against the RV, the truck, or a wide tree trunk; thighs parallel to the ground, knees at 90 deg. Time-based.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Rise onto the toes, pause a beat at the top, lower slowly. Flat ground is fine; a raised edge adds range if you have one.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Calf raise on one foot, resting a fingertip on something for balance only.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.setup: On hands and knees, drive one heel toward the sky keeping the knee bent at 90 deg. Do not arch the low back.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.setup: On hands and knees, lift one knee out to the side keeping it bent. Keep the hips square.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.setup: Classic jumping jack. Good opener to raise the heart rate. Time-based.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.setup: Run in place driving the knees to hip height, staying on the balls of the feet. Time-based.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.setup: High plank, drive the knees to the chest alternately at pace. Hips stay low. Time-based.

exercises.name: Squat Thrust
exercises.setup: From standing, hands down, jump the feet back to a plank, jump them in, stand. A burpee without the push-up or jump.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.setup: Squat down, jump back to a plank, chest to the ground, jump the feet in, jump up with hands overhead.

exercises.name: Sprawl
exercises.setup: Burpee without the jump — drop to the plank and snap the hips down, then pop straight back up. Easier on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.setup: Hands and feet down, knees hovering just off the ground. Crawl forward and back moving opposite hand and foot. Time-based.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
exercises.setup: Sit, hands behind you, hips lifted. Walk forward and back on hands and feet. Time-based.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.setup: Hinge and walk the hands out to a plank, hold a beat, walk the feet up to the hands, stand.

exercises.name: Skater Jump
exercises.setup: Bound laterally from one foot to the other, landing softly and controlling the balance each side.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Get-Up
exercises.setup: From lying on your back, stand up one deliberate step at a time with one arm held straight overhead, then reverse it.

exercises.name: One-Arm Push-Up
exercises.setup: Feet wide for a stable base, one hand behind your back or resting on your hip. Brace hard through the midline and lower under control, elbow tracking back at roughly 45 degrees; press back to full lockout without letting your hips rotate open.

exercises.name: Banded Archer Row
exercises.setup: Band anchored at chest height. Wide stance facing the anchor, one arm rows the band fully to the ribs while the other arm stays extended straight out to the side, resisting the pull. Full rows on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Push-Up
exercises.setup: Kick up into a handstand against a wall, chest facing the wall, hands shoulder-width. Lower your head toward the floor under control, elbows tracking forward, then press back to full lockout. Keep reps small and deliberate — this is an advanced inversion; skip it without a wall and a clear head-landing zone.

exercises.name: Archer Pull-Up
exercises.setup: From a wide-grip dead hang, pull yourself up toward one hand while the other arm stays straight and rides along the bar. Lower under control and alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.setup: Band held wide in both hands, elbows bent 90 degrees and pinned at your sides. Rotate your forearms outward against the band, then back to center. Elbows stay glued to your ribs the whole time.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.setup: On hands and knees. Thread one arm underneath your body, rotating your chest toward the floor, then reverse and rotate that same arm up toward the ceiling, following it with your eyes. Slow and controlled; switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Band Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Sit tall with legs straight, band under your seat, ends at shoulder height. Press straight overhead without leaning back.

exercises.name: Tall-Kneeling Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Kneel upright on both knees with the band under your shins. Squeeze glutes and press overhead, ribs down, no arching.

exercises.name: Banded Arnold Press
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, palms facing you at chest height. Rotate palms out as you press overhead, reverse on the way down.

exercises.name: Banded Push Press
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hands at shoulders. Dip a few inches at the knees and drive the band overhead, finishing with straight arms.

exercises.name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
exercises.setup: Feet on a step or low bench, hips high in an inverted V. Lower the crown of your head toward the floor, then press back up.

exercises.name: Low-Bar Hang
exercises.setup: Grip a waist-height bar and walk your feet forward until your arms take some weight. Hang back with straight arms. Time-based.

exercises.name: Prone Band Pulldown
exercises.setup: Lie face down holding the band wide overhead. Pull the band down toward your upper back, lifting your chest slightly.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Band Pulldown
exercises.setup: Anchor the band overhead and hold one end. Pull your elbow down to your ribs, keeping the torso still.

exercises.name: Kneeling Band Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Kneel below an overhead anchor, both hands on the band. Pull down and out to your collarbones, elbows driving to your sides.

exercises.name: Tempo Bodyweight Squat
exercises.setup: Bodyweight squat taking three slow seconds to descend, then stand normally. Chest up, knees tracking over the toes.

exercises.name: Banded Sumo Squat
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band with a wide stance, toes turned out, hands at chest. Squat straight down between your heels.

exercises.name: Banded Pause Squat
exercises.setup: Stand mid-band, hands at chest. Squat down, hold the bottom for two seconds without relaxing, then stand.

exercises.name: High Plank
exercises.setup: Hands under shoulders, arms straight, body in one line from heels to head. Squeeze glutes, ribs down. Time-based.

exercises.name: Bear Hold
exercises.setup: On hands and knees, toes tucked, knees hovering an inch off the floor. Keep a flat back and breathe. Time-based.

exercises.name: Banded Lat Pull Hold
exercises.setup: Anchor the band high, hold both ends and pull down to chest height. Hold that position, shoulders down and back. Time-based.
